name: Uber
title: Uber carried 62% of NYC trips in Aug 2026

subtitles.share_trend: Uber's share of NYC trips rose 2.8 pts between Aug 2025 and Aug 2026
subtitles.fpm_dist: The median Uber fare per mile rose 1.9% between Aug 2025 and Aug 2026, to $6.31/mile; most trips paid $3.41/mile to $12.43/mile (10th to 90th percentile)
subtitles.tip_rate: Uber riders tipped 4.3% of the base fare in Aug 2026 (+0.2 pts on a year earlier)
subtitles.wav: Uber completed 43,600 trips that requested a wheelchair-accessible vehicle in Aug 2026, and 12% of all its trips ran in one; requests that went unfilled aren't in TLC's records
subtitles.shared: Uber riders made 270,000 shared-ride requests in Aug 2026, and 60% were matched
subtitles.compare: The median Uber fare per mile, $6.31/mile in Aug 2026, was the lowest of 4 companies
subtitles.lyft_vs_uber: Lyft had a bigger share of pickups than Uber in 1 zone in Aug 2026, the same as a year earlier
